notes_for_human:
DIRECT ANSWER ON UNDERGRADUATE AVAILABILITY: Skadden's Summer Associate Program is NOT open to undergraduates. Skadden states verbatim on its own domain (tier 1): "Our Summer Associate Program is geared towards students in three-year J.D. programs in the United States who will be admitted to practice law in the United States." (https://www.skadden.com/careers/attorneys/law-students-and-graduates/united-kingdom, checked 2026-07-29). The entire program sits under a section of the site titled "Law Students and Graduates," and the US page's recruiting cycles are organised around 1L and 2L candidates. An undergraduate with no J.D. enrollment does not meet the stated criterion. Note the confusing detail that Skadden asks summer-associate applicants for an UNDERGRADUATE transcript - that is a document request from an enrolled law student, not evidence the program admits undergraduates.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY OPEN TO UNDERGRADUATES: exactly one program found - the Legal Practice Assistant (LPA) program in the Paralegal Services Department, stated verbatim to be "tailored for recent college graduates." Two things must be flagged to any undergraduate user: (1) it is a full-time two-year JOB starting after graduation, not a summer internship - Skadden states "We expect our LPAs to commit to a two-year tenure at the firm"; (2) it therefore targets final-year students / graduating seniors, not sophomores or juniors seeking a summer placement. No summer internship, insight day, spring week, or first-year/sophomore diversity program for undergraduates was found anywhere on skadden.com.

1L SCHOLARS: both indexed URLs for the 1L Scholars program returned Skadden's 404 page on 2026-07-29. Search engines still index the pages and a University of Michigan Law event listing references an info session, but no live Skadden page states its eligibility. Recorded as dead, not as silent, and not guessed. If the database needs this field, it should be re-checked; the program may have been renamed, moved, or discontinued. Even if live, it is by definition for first-year law students, not undergraduates.

METHOD CAVEAT: skadden.com is an AngularJS client-rendered site - every route returns an identical 17,726-byte JS shell to a plain HTTP GET, so raw-HTML verification is impossible. Only two pages yielded genuinely verbatim body text (the UK law students page and the paralegals page); all quotes in this record come from those two. Where only a paraphrased rendering was available (US summer associate page: application requirements, third-party online assessment, salary figure), fields are marked "unverified" with empty quote fields rather than back-filled from a summary. Compensation for both programs is therefore NOT established from the public record here.

COOLING-OFF: no reapplication waiting period, assessment-retake limit, or rejection-based restriction was found for any Skadden program. Recorded as silent, which is a statement about the public record only.
